subject: Engineering Mathematics III
chapters: Chapter 2: Fourier Transforms & Fast Fourier Transform
Chapter 6: Partial Differential Equations & Wave/Heat Equations

questions.text: Find the Determinant and Inverse of a matrix using Gauss-Jordan method. Find Rank of a matrix by reducing to Echelon normal form. Solve system of linear equations $AX = B$ using Cramer's Rule and Matrix Inversion Method.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Fourier Transforms & Fast Fourier Transform
questions.text: Find the Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors of matrix $A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 2 \end{bmatrix}$. State Cayley-Hamilton Theorem, verify for matrix $A$, and find $A^{-1}$ and $A^4$. Explain Diagonalization of matrices.

State Dirichlet's conditions. Obtain the Fourier Series expansion of $f(x) = x^2$ or $f(x) = |x|$ in the interval $(-\pi, \pi)$ and deduce that $\frac{1}{1^2} + \frac{1}{2^2} + \frac{1}{3^2} + \dots = \frac{\pi^2}{6}$. Obtain Half-Range Fourier Sine and Cosine series.

Define Analytic Function. State and derive Cauchy-Riemann (C-R) Equations in Cartesian and Polar forms. Show that $f(z) = \sin z$ is analytic and find its derivative. If $u(x, y) = x^3 - 3xy^2 + 3x^2 - 3y^2 + 1$, find harmonic conjugate $v(x, y)$ and $f(z)$ using Milne-Thomson method.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Partial Differential Equations & Wave/Heat Equations
questions.text: State Cauchy's Integral Theorem and Cauchy's Integral Formula: $f(z_0) = \frac{1}{2\pi i} \oint_C \frac{f(z)}{z - z_0} dz$. State Cauchy's Residue Theorem and evaluate contour integral $\oint_C \frac{z^2 + 1}{(z-1)(z-2)} dz$ around $|z| = 3$.
